**Chinese name:** 上海壁仞智能科技有限公司 (Shànghǎi Bìrèn Zhìnéng Kējì Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded September 2019 by former SenseTime president Zhang Wen and former Huawei engineer Jiao Guofang; one of two Chinese GPU startups (with Moore Threads) directly named in the US Commerce Department's October 17, 2023 Entity List action targeting AI chip designers with a Foreign Direct Product Rule designation, the most restrictive tier.
:::

## What does this firm design?

General-purpose GPUs for AI compute, led by the BR100 series, competing directly in the segment most exposed to Nvidia export restrictions.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2019 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | General-purpose GPUs for AI training and inference (BR100 series) |
| **Node Sophistication** | Designed for leading-edge nodes; fabrication access constrained by its Entity List status |
| **Entity List** | Yes — US Commerce BIS (Footnote 4 Foreign Direct Product Rule) |
